statutoryAuthority.ruleStatement: A person convicted of a qualifying felony, or qualifying felonies arising from the same occurrence or related course of events, may petition the convicting court after at least ten years from expiration of all sentence terms including probation, completion of any court-ordered program, and payment of court-ordered restitution. The section also carries the other-felony bar, firearm limitation, statutory exclusion list, substantial-danger finding, one-per-lifetime limit, and restoration-of-rights effect recorded in the approved route design.
doNotImport: Do not offer this route for a completed felony deferral; § 7-13-1502 requires a conviction.
Do not decide that an offense is absent from the statute-specific exclusion list or that a participant presents no substantial danger.
Do not assert that the participant has no other felony plea, nolo plea, or conviction anywhere.
Do not promise an entitlement to answer an inquiry as though the conviction did not occur.
Do not invent a statewide form number, local template, DCI service address, or notarization rule.
Do not extend the subsection (m) restoration sentence to another Wyoming route.

requiredFacts.use: petitioner identity across all five components
petitioner mailing address, telephone, and email
convicting court, judicial district, county, and docket number copied from the judgment and sentence
felony offense and statute of conviction copied exactly from the judgment and sentence
conviction or judgment-entry date copied from the court record
date all sentence terms expired, including probation, confirmed from discharge documentation
whether restitution was ordered and when it was paid in full
participant statement that no prior § 7-13-1502 expungement was received
participant statement about any other felony plea, nolo plea, or conviction anywhere
participant statement checked with counsel that the felony is not on the § 7-13-1502 exclusion list
prosecutor and DCI identity, current addresses, dates, and manners of service

finalVerificationRequirements: Confirm from the judgment and sentence that the matter is a conviction rather than a completed felony deferral.
Copy the convicting court, district, county, docket number, felony wording, statute, and conviction date from the judgment and sentence.
Confirm from discharge records that ten years have passed since every sentence term, including probation, expired and any court-ordered program was completed.
Confirm from the clerk's record that court-ordered restitution was paid in full or none was ordered.

The participant and attorney-review gate address the other-felony bar, firearm limitation, statutory exclusion list, one-per-lifetime limit, and substantial-danger showing; the packet does not decide them.
Confirm current prosecutor and DCI service addresses before service and complete the certificate only after service occurs.
The participant signs and verifies the petition; confirm any local notarization practice with the convicting-court clerk.

serviceAndNotice.statement: Serve the verified petition on the prosecuting attorney and the Division of Criminal Investigation and file proof of service. The prosecutor has 90 days to object and, not the petitioner, notifies identifiable victims.

postFilingTimeline.step: Serve the verified petition on the prosecuting attorney and DCI and file proof of service.
postFilingTimeline.timing: after filing under the local mechanics confirmed with the clerk

postFilingTimeline.step: The prosecuting attorney may object and is responsible for notifying identifiable victims.

hearingAndObjectionStops.situation: The felony may be on the § 7-13-1502 exclusion list, another felony appears anywhere, firearm use is involved, or the participant already received a § 7-13-1502 expungement.
hearingAndObjectionStops.whatItMeans: The approved route requires attorney review and the packet does not decide eligibility.

hearingAndObjectionStops.situation: The matter was a completed felony deferral rather than a conviction.
hearingAndObjectionStops.whatItMeans: This conviction-expungement route does not apply and no other expungement route may be substituted.

hearingAndObjectionStops.situation: The prosecutor objects, an identifiable victim is likely to object, or the court sets a contested hearing.
hearingAndObjectionStops.whatItMeans: The matter has crossed the approved self-help boundary.

participantChecklist.text: Confirm from the judgment that this was a conviction, not a completed felony deferral.
Confirm the ten-year interval and all sentence, program, and restitution completion facts from records.
Complete the required attorney review of the exclusion list, other-felony bar, firearm limitation, and substantial-danger showing.
Confirm local filing, copy, proposed-order, verification, and notarization mechanics with the convicting-court clerk.
Confirm current addresses, serve both the prosecuting attorney and DCI, and complete proof of service after service occurs.
